key_findings: CFA-induced prostate CPPS in rats raised TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, PGE2 and P2X7R/NLRP3/caspase-1/IL-18 mRNA.
Electroacupuncture reduced these, raised thermal pain threshold, and downregulated the P2X7R/NLRP3 pathway.
